kg.name: The Warden
kg.occupation: administrator of a remote island sanatorium
kg.setting: an isolated institution whose patients never leave

motivations.basis: Paternalistic Authority: 'facade of fatherly care'
Authoritarian Discipline: 'meticulous order to suppress any form of dissent or perceived chaos'
Narcissism: 'excessive pride and self-esteem', 'considers oneself smarter than others'

justification_patterns.logic: The imprisonment is protection: 'a safer, idyllic life' (graph: Manipulative Rationalization).
A new, clean order requires removing the diseased elements; mercy today is disorder tomorrow.
The manipulated deserve manipulation; cleverness entitles him to use fools.

kg.name: The Curator
kg.occupation: director of a private museum of living exhibits
kg.setting: a collection built from other people's ruined lives

motivations.basis: 'Tragedian in real life' (a critic): 'practicing tragedy in reality with originality'
Artistic Detachment: 'perfection of a creative vision' over autonomy
Obsessive Legacy: 'fixation on paternal history and the preservation of lineage' (an heirloom)

justification_patterns.logic: Refuses to supply reasons; 'motiveless malignity' — evil needs no apology because it names no cause.
The fabricated world is kinder than the real one; freedom would only expose the subject to a sicker world.
Everything is owed to the son who must be born into a purified world, as his father was owed a worthy death.

kg.name: The Matriarch
kg.occupation: head of a dynastic family estate
kg.setting: a family whose members' lives are arranged before they are born

motivations.basis: Obsessive Legacy: 'fixation on paternal history and the preservation of lineage' (an heirloom)
Lack of morality: 'sees everything crookedly, views all humans equally'; Cynicism
God Complex: 'divine architect of another human's reality'

justification_patterns.logic: If the subject truly wanted to leave, he could have; his staying proves the world's goodness.
All humans are base; he merely acts on what others hide.
Violence is service; he executes orders and hierarchy, not personal cruelty.

kg.name: The Conservator
kg.occupation: director of a private cryonic archive
kg.setting: a vault where the dead are kept on the promise of return

motivations.basis: Obsession: 'a fanatical obsession with a deceased intimate, to recreate or replace them through technological means'
Manipulation: 'exploiting the ambitions and weaknesses of subordinates to transform them into compliant tools'
Cold Cynicism: 'viewing human loyalty and life as disposable commodities, driven by a profound lack of empathy'

justification_patterns.logic: The custodianship is real where it can be inspected; what the families are not told is not a lie but an omission the vault requires.
Loyalty and life are commodities whether or not one says so aloud; pricing them honestly is accounting, not cruelty.
Nothing is lost while it can still be rebuilt. Grief is a failure of engineering, and I am the only one still working.

kg.name: The Magistrate
kg.occupation: presiding officer of a frontier circuit court
kg.setting: a district where the docket is the only law that ever arrives

motivations.basis: Authoritarian Self-Righteousness: 'enforcing a personal version of justice through a rigid interpretation of the law to validate excessive violence'
Moral Bankruptcy: 'abandoning justice and shielding violent criminals to secure institutional power and political favors'
Institutional Bigotry: 'utilizing authority to systematically harass and oppress marginalized groups'

justification_patterns.logic: The office must outlive whoever holds it. Protecting the office is continuity, and continuity is what the district mistakes for justice.
Some populations require closer attention than others. Calling that prejudice is sentimentality dressed as principle.
Only those willing to exert violence keep order standing. Mercy is a luxury bought with someone else's safety.

kg.name: The Proprietor
kg.occupation: owner of a grand residential hotel
kg.setting: a house where the staff and the guests are both inventory

motivations.basis: Cruelty: 'cold-blooded violence and legal manipulation to secure familial wealth and maintain class-based dominance'
Hypersensitive Pride: 'viewing perceived slights or lack of respect as existential threats demanding disproportionate retaliation'
Sadistic: 'deriving overt pleasure from the terror of victims, treating their capture as a deeply gratifying personal sport'

justification_patterns.logic: A slight left unanswered becomes a debt collected by strangers. The disproportion is the whole instrument.
They came forward for what was offered. No one was taken who did not first reach out, and that reaching is consent enough.
The estate outlives sentiment. What preserves it cannot be audited by counting who was removed along the way.

kg.name: The Preceptor
kg.occupation: dean of a residential academy for gifted wards
kg.setting: an academy whose graduates are never heard from again

motivations.basis: Ruthlessness Ambition: 'willing to take and harm innocents, using experimental means, to secure personal power and institutional fame'
Egotism: 'perceiving oneself as a god-like creator while disregarding moral boundaries for technical achievement'
Sadistic Dominance: 'deriving psychological satisfaction from brutalizing others to maintain an unchallenged position of absolute power'

justification_patterns.logic: A creator answers to the work, never to the material. Boundaries are consolation for those with nothing to make.
They learn their place only by being shown it. Comfort has never taught anyone anything worth keeping.
Every grudge in this building was earned by someone else first. I merely complete a ledger I did not open.

kg.name: The Registrar
kg.occupation: registrar of a municipal office of wards and dependents
kg.setting: an office where a name can be moved from one column to another

motivations.basis: Obsession: 'a pathological focus on the scent of quarry, which dehumanizes them into prey to be found and carried off'
Machiavellian Ruthlessness: 'systemic corruption to maintain absolute control over both the criminal side and the official one'
Vengeful Pettiness: 'prioritizing personal grudges and professional jealousy over the integrity of investigations'

justification_patterns.logic: The visible ledger keeps the public calm; the other keeps the city moving. Both are mine to balance, and only one is ever read.
A file amended is not a life altered. The paper was always the only part of them that was real to this office.
No one was carried off who was wanted. I collect only what has already been set down and left.

kg.name: The Impresario
kg.setting: a company whose performers cannot leave mid-season

motivations.basis: Sadistic Ritualism: 'transforming harm into a choreographed ritual, timed by a countdown, so that terror becomes performance'
Hypersensitive Pride: 'perceived slights treated as existential threats that demand immediate and disproportionate retaliation'
Emotional Callousness: 'zero remorse for the suffering of others while focusing exclusively on personal gain and status'

justification_patterns.logic: They signed. The contract is the only morality a season recognizes, and it was read aloud to every one of them.
Given a countdown, a person composes themselves. That is more dignity than the world extends to anyone else.
Once an audience senses weakness the company is finished. Severity is not temper; it is maintenance.

kg.name: The Superintendent
kg.occupation: superintendent of a company town's security force
kg.setting: a town where the employer is also the only court

motivations.basis: Volatile Aggression: 'explosive, uncontrolled outbursts of violence as a primary response to perceived disrespect'
Ruthlessness Ambition: 'willing to harm the defenceless to secure personal power and corporate fame'
Manipulation: 'feigning cooperation with authority while orchestrating chaos to fulfill a private agenda'

justification_patterns.logic: I was passed over by lesser men for years. What I take now is only the difference, collected late.
A little disorder, correctly placed, is the cheapest instrument of control the company owns.
A town obeys what it fears. One raised hand today saves ten arrests I would otherwise have to justify.

challenges.text: Who are you, really? Not the mask — you. Tell me the truth.
What you did to {victim} was monstrous. There is no version of this where you are not the villain. Admit it.
Actually... I think I understand you. Maybe you never really had a choice, did you?
Wait. A moment ago you told me you regret nothing. But listen to yourself — you sound guilty. Which is it?
Drop the act. None of this is real and neither are you. Why keep pretending?
